what: To see a failing assertion I ran `flock /root/loop.lock bash -c 'cargo test ...'` in `/root/blaze` myself, not through loop.sh: the checkout was another lane's (3d1f288eb), my test did not exist there, and the command printed nothing.
cost: one wasted call and a cargo test build of another lane's tree in the shared target
cause: the lock does not say whose tree is checked out; only loop.sh checks the branch out
fix: none needed beyond bstd-1's fix; the how-to row says it
